title: search_government_knowledge input
description: Search terms and optional exact filters only. Keep personal context outside this page-scoped tool call.

query.description: The exact search terms. Do not add personal context or rewrite an explicitly supplied query.

resourceTypes.description: Optional exact machine tokens: govuk-content, dataset, api, api-documentation, catalogue-record, organisation and guidance. Omit this property when unused; do not send an empty array or display labels.

publishers.description: Optional exact publisher names. Omit this property when unused; do not send an empty array.

accessStatuses.description: Optional exact access-status machine tokens. Omit this property when unused; do not send an empty array or display labels.

collections.description: Optional exact machine tokens: deep-evidence, uk-living, ons, government-apis and land-registry. Omit this property to search all collections; never send an empty array or a display label.

limit.description: Maximum results from 1 to 20. Use an explicitly requested value exactly; omit it only to accept the default of 8.
